| @ CNERGY COMBAT
. 2X Energy attack costing 3 stages.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
HIT: Attach to your opponent’s MP. While attached,

at the beginning of each turn, your opponent banishes

the top card of their Life Deck. Banish this card
when your opponent deals critical damage.
